investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Fintrail (payments and invoicing SaaS); Platform: Google Cloud europe-west1; Kubernetes cluster: fintrail-prod-ew1 (GKE, node range 10.70.0.0/20); Managed database: Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL instance orders-db (private IP 10.70.8.3); Deployments: Helm releases rolled out by a CI release bot after human approval; Change management: CHG- identifiers.
